content: We need to determine number of methyl groups in the sample's molecule. We have no description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see methyl signals (singlet ~0.9 ppm). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). We need to measure spectra. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool. Then analyze peaks. Let's call tool.
